extension.summary: Practical Kodi add-ons for LibreELEC and Raspberry Pi
extension.description: Monteiro is a collection of practical, open-source Kodi add-ons for LibreELEC and Raspberry Pi. It provides a single place to install and update utilities that simplify your media-center setup. The collection currently includes HDMI Switcher, which lets you choose the active HDMI display directly from Kodi, Easy Channel, which plays M3U lists in a TV box style screen and keeps only the channels that work, and Easy Movie, which shows the movies of M3U lists as a poster catalog. New tools and updates are published through this repository.
extension.news: 1.0.5 - Added Easy Movie to the description.

extension.summary: A simple file manager for the remote control
Um gerenciador de arquivos simples para o controle remoto
extension.description: Easy Files browses your drives, network shares and the folders of Kodi in the design of the Monteiro add-ons, with places on the left and the folder on the right. OK opens a folder or plays a file. Hold OK on a file or folder to open, rename, copy, move or delete it, create a folder, or see its details: type, size, contents, date and the free space of the drive. Copies show their progress and can be cancelled.

O Easy Files navega pelos seus discos, compartilhamentos de rede e pastas do Kodi no visual dos add-ons Monteiro, com os locais à esquerda e a pasta à direita. OK abre uma pasta ou toca um arquivo. Segure OK num arquivo ou pasta para abrir, renomear, copiar, mover ou apagar, criar uma pasta ou ver os detalhes: tipo, tamanho, conteúdo, data e espaço livre do disco. As cópias mostram o progresso e podem ser canceladas.
extension.news: 1.0.1 - The focus is steel blue with white text, as in the Monteiro skin. 1.0.0 - First release.

extension.summary: Your music by playlist, with a player always at hand
Suas músicas por playlist, com o player sempre à mão
extension.description: Easy Music plays the music of your folders in the design of the Monteiro add-ons. The playlists, one for each folder, are on the left, their songs are on the right, and the player is in a bar at the bottom, with the cover, title and artist of the song, play and pause, previous and next, shuffle, repeat, a heart for the songs you like, and the progress of the song. Hold OK on a song to play it next, add it to the queue, like it or see its details. The music goes on when Easy Music closes.

O Easy Music toca as músicas das suas pastas no visual dos add-ons Monteiro. As playlists, uma para cada pasta, ficam à esquerda, as músicas à direita, e o player fica numa barra embaixo, com a capa, o título e o artista da música, tocar e pausar, anterior e próxima, aleatório, repetir, um coração para as músicas que você curte e o progresso da música. Segure OK numa música para tocá-la em seguida, adicioná-la à fila, curti-la ou ver os detalhes. A música continua tocando quando o Easy Music fecha.

extension.summary: Your photos in a gallery, for the remote control
Suas fotos em galeria, para o controle remoto
extension.description: Easy Picture shows the photos of your folders in the design of the Monteiro add-ons, with the albums on the left and the pictures of the album on the right, in a gallery. All pictures and your favorites come first, then one album for each folder. OK shows a picture in full screen, and Left and Right move to the next and previous ones. Hold OK on a picture to mark it as favorite, rotate or flip it, or see its details: date, size, resolution and folder.

O Easy Picture mostra as fotos das suas pastas no visual dos add-ons Monteiro, com os álbuns à esquerda e as fotos do álbum à direita, em galeria. Todas as imagens e as suas favoritas vêm primeiro, e depois um álbum para cada pasta. OK mostra a foto em tela cheia, e Esquerda e Direita passam para a próxima e a anterior. Segure OK numa foto para marcá-la como favorita, girá-la ou espelhá-la, ou ver os detalhes: data, tamanho, resolução e pasta.
extension.news: 1.1.1 - In full screen, the name, album, date and position of the picture show in a bar at the bottom, in the colors of the theme. 1.1.0 - Hold OK on a picture to rotate it 90 degrees right or left, or flip it horizontally or vertically, in the gallery and in full screen. The file of the picture does not change, and Original position undoes it. 1.0.0 - First release.

extension.summary: Choose your active HDMI display directly from Kodi
Escolha a tela HDMI ativa direto pelo Kodi
extension.description: Switch between a small HDMI display and an external monitor on LibreELEC for Raspberry Pi 4. Pick a display from two cards that show which one is active and which ones are connected, confirm your choice, and Kodi restarts on it. Your display preference is saved for future starts. Existing advanced settings are preserved, and a backup is created before the first change to an existing configuration file. Switching stops current playback and uses one display at a time.

Alterne entre uma tela HDMI pequena e um monitor externo no LibreELEC para Raspberry Pi 4. Escolha a tela em dois cartões que mostram qual está ativa e quais estão conectadas, confirme, e o Kodi reinicia nela. A tela escolhida fica salva para as próximas inicializações. As configurações avançadas existentes são preservadas, e um backup é criado antes da primeira alteração de um arquivo de configuração existente. A troca interrompe o que estiver tocando e usa uma tela por vez.
extension.news: 1.1.3 - The focus is steel blue with white text, as in the Monteiro skin. 1.1.2 - The icon and fanart have new file names, so Kodi shows the new artwork instead of a cached copy of the previous icon. 1.1.1 - The display picker opens on the active display, which now has a blue outline and check mark. 1.1.0 - New dark display picker matching Easy Channel and Easy Movie, new icon, and Brazilian Portuguese translation.

extension.summary: TV box style player for M3U lists that keeps only the channels that work
Player de listas M3U no estilo TV Box que mantém só os canais que funcionam
extension.description: Easy Channel plays M3U lists in a TV box style screen, with groups on the left, channels in the middle and details of the focused channel on the right. Add lists from a web address, a file, or the M3U files of a GitHub repository, all from one manager window and without extra configuration. When a channel fails to play, Easy Channel offers to remove it, so your lists keep only working channels. Mark favorites, check a whole group at once, restore removed channels at any time, and export a clean M3U file. Selecting TV in Kodi's main menu opens Easy Channel.

O Easy Channel reproduz listas M3U numa tela no estilo TV Box, com os grupos à esquerda, os canais no centro e os detalhes do canal em foco à direita. Adicione listas por endereço web, por arquivo ou a partir dos arquivos M3U de um repositório do GitHub, tudo numa única janela de gerenciamento e sem configurações extras. Quando um canal falha ao abrir, o Easy Channel oferece removê-lo, para que suas listas fiquem só com canais que funcionam. Marque favoritos, verifique um grupo inteiro de uma vez, restaure canais removidos quando quiser e exporte um arquivo M3U limpo. Selecionar TV no menu principal do Kodi abre o Easy Channel.
extension.disclaimer: Easy Channel does not provide any content. It plays the lists you add, and you are responsible for using only lists you are allowed to watch. The suggested GitHub repositories collect publicly available, free channels and are maintained by third parties.

O Easy Channel não fornece nenhum conteúdo. Ele reproduz as listas que você adiciona, e você é responsável por usar apenas listas que tem permissão para assistir. Os repositórios do GitHub sugeridos reúnem canais públicos e gratuitos e são mantidos por terceiros.
extension.news: 1.2.1 - The focus is steel blue with white text, as in the Monteiro skin. 1.2.0 - Groups can be renamed and deleted: hold OK on a group, or press Menu. A renamed group keeps its name when the list is updated, and the channels of a deleted group can be restored from Removed channels. 1.1.0 - New TV player: channels open in full screen with a channel bar showing the logo, number, name, group and connection state, with a star for adding the channel to Favorites. Up and Down change channel, Right reaches the favorite star, OK shows the bar, Menu opens the Kodi player and Back returns to the list. 1.0.1 - Moving quickly between groups no longer shows the channels of a group you already left. Changing channels no longer reports the new channel as not working. Opening the channel that is already playing shows it in full screen instead of starting it again. Right after the remove button moves to the preview, and OK there opens full screen. 1.0.0 - First release.

extension.summary: Movie and series catalog for M3U lists that keeps only what works
Catálogo de filmes e séries para listas M3U que mantém só o que funciona
extension.description: Easy Movie shows the movies of your M3U lists as a poster catalog, with genres on the left and posters on the right. Episodes are grouped into series automatically, with seasons, episodes and a Continue button for the next episode. Watched movies and episodes are marked, and a Continue watching group resumes them where you stopped. Open a movie to see its details and play it, add it to your favorites, or remove it. Add lists from a web address, a file, or the M3U files of a GitHub repository, all from one manager window and without extra configuration. When a movie fails to play, Easy Movie offers to remove it, so your lists keep only working movies. Check a whole genre at once, restore removed movies at any time, and export a clean M3U file. With an empty library, selecting Movies or TV shows in Kodi's main menu opens Easy Movie. You can also add folders with your own video files, with posters and details from Cinemeta, and browse the movies and series of the Cinemeta catalog. Movies play with controls in the style of streaming apps, with 10 second skips, subtitles and audio tracks, and subtitles from OpenSubtitles turn on automatically in your language.

O Easy Movie mostra os filmes das suas listas M3U como um catálogo de pôsteres, com os gêneros à esquerda e os pôsteres à direita. Os episódios são agrupados em séries automaticamente, com temporadas, episódios e um botão Continuar para o próximo episódio. Filmes e episódios assistidos ficam marcados, e o grupo Continuar assistindo retoma de onde você parou. Abra um filme para ver os detalhes e assistir, adicionar aos favoritos ou remover. Adicione listas por endereço web, por arquivo ou a partir dos arquivos M3U de um repositório do GitHub, tudo numa única janela de gerenciamento e sem configurações extras. Quando um filme falha ao abrir, o Easy Movie oferece removê-lo, para que suas listas fiquem só com filmes que funcionam. Verifique um gênero inteiro de uma vez, restaure filmes removidos quando quiser e exporte um arquivo M3U limpo. Com a biblioteca vazia, selecionar Filmes ou Seriados no menu principal do Kodi abre o Easy Movie. Você também pode adicionar pastas com os seus próprios vídeos, com pôsteres e detalhes do Cinemeta, e navegar pelos filmes e séries do catálogo do Cinemeta. Os filmes tocam com controles no estilo dos apps de streaming, com pulos de 10 segundos, legendas e faixas de áudio, e legendas do OpenSubtitles são ligadas automaticamente no seu idioma.
extension.disclaimer: Easy Movie does not provide any content. It plays the lists you add, and you are responsible for using only lists you are allowed to watch. The suggested GitHub repository lists public domain movies and is maintained by a third party.

O Easy Movie não fornece nenhum conteúdo. Ele reproduz as listas que você adiciona, e você é responsável por usar apenas listas que tem permissão para assistir. O repositório do GitHub sugerido reúne filmes em domínio público e é mantido por terceiros.
extension.news: 1.6.1 - The focus is steel blue with white text, as in the Monteiro skin. 1.6.0 - Online subtitles: subtitles from OpenSubtitles turn on automatically in your language when a movie has none, Brazilian Portuguese first, and more can be picked in the subtitles panel. The hash of video files finds the subtitles made for them. No account is needed. 1.5.0 - Playback controls in the style of streaming apps: play and pause between back and forward 10 seconds, Left and Right skip 10 seconds, and subtitle and audio tracks in a side panel. All movies and the genres show the newest movies first. Video folders on the device are read again each time, so finished downloads show at once, and the folder of a single movie or series is no longer a genre. The catalog keeps its selection when more titles load. 1.4.0 - Catalog: a new toolbar icon opens the movies and series of Cinemeta, the catalog of Stremio, by popularity, year and genre, with search, details, seasons and episodes, and My list. Titles in your lists can be played from it. Stremio addons can be added by their address: their catalogs are shown too, and their sources open in a side panel, where a torrent goes to Downloads, only the chosen file of a pack, and a direct link plays at once. Downloads shows the free space of the folder and when it is full. Removed movies moved to the list manager. 1.3.0 - Torrent downloads: a Downloads screen in the toolbar adds magnet links and .torrent files to a folder you choose and lists the downloads with their progress, speed and time left. Downloads resume when Kodi starts. Uses the Torrest engine, included for all platforms. 1.2.0 - Video folders: add folders with your own video files from the SD card, a USB drive or a network share, with posters and details from Cinemeta, series recognized by folder, and options to rename and delete files. 1.1.3 - Moving quickly between groups no longer shows the movies of a group you already left. Opening a movie or episode while another one plays no longer reports it as not working. 1.1.2 - Streams are checked before playing while the details window stays open, so Kodi no longer freezes on servers that do not answer. 1.1.1 - Series from lists that keep the show name in pltv-subgroup, codes such as T01|EP01, 01|EP01 and EP001, and episodes that share a code. pltv-subgroup is also used as the genre of movies. 1.1.0 - Series: episodes are grouped into series with seasons and a Continue button. Watched marks, resume, a Continue watching group, the TV shows menu, and a blue focus on posters. 1.0.0 - First release.

extension.summary: Every add-on of your repositories in one list, with its category
Todos os add-ons dos seus repositórios numa lista, com a categoria de cada um
extension.description: Monteiro Add-ons shows the add-ons of the repositories installed in Kodi in the design of the Monteiro add-ons, with the repositories on the left and their add-ons on the right, in one list instead of categories. Each add-on shows its category, such as Look and feel, Program add-ons or Video add-ons, its version, a green check when it is installed, and whether it has an update. OK shows the details of an add-on, with its description and screenshots, to install it or open it. The Monteiro skin opens it from Repositories in the add-on browser.

O Monteiro Add-ons mostra os add-ons dos repositórios instalados no Kodi no visual dos add-ons Monteiro, com os repositórios à esquerda e os add-ons à direita, numa lista só em vez de categorias. Cada add-on mostra a categoria, como Olhar e sentir, Add-ons de programas ou Add-ons de vídeo, a versão, um check verde quando está instalado, e se tem atualização. OK mostra os detalhes de um add-on, com a descrição e as capturas de tela, para instalá-lo ou abri-lo. O skin Monteiro o abre em Repositórios, na tela de add-ons.

extension.summary: The design of Easy Channel and Easy Movie for all of Kodi
O visual do Easy Channel e do Easy Movie em todo o Kodi
extension.description: A dark skin for the living room, in the design of the Monteiro add-ons. TV, Movies and Series on the home screen open Easy Channel and Easy Movie directly. Videos, Music and Pictures, confirmations, menus, the keyboard, settings, the add-on browser, the file manager and the player controls share the same look. Live TV, profiles, favourites, games and the details of videos, music and pictures are included too. Preview version: some rarely used windows, such as the playlist and smart playlist editors, the color picker and game controllers, are not included yet.

Um skin escuro para a sala, no visual dos add-ons Monteiro. TV, Filmes e Séries na tela inicial abrem direto o Easy Channel e o Easy Movie. Vídeos, Música e Imagens, confirmações, menus, o teclado, as configurações, a tela de add-ons, o gerenciador de arquivos e os controles do player têm o mesmo visual. TV ao vivo, perfis, favoritos, jogos e os detalhes de vídeos, músicas e imagens também estão incluídos. Versão de prévia: algumas telas pouco usadas, como os editores de playlists, o seletor de cores e os controles de jogos, ainda não estão incluídas.
